Storage Medium

  • CURIE: gmeow:StorageMedium
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/StorageMedium
  • Category: class
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/places

The kind of medium a storage location uses (cloud service, local filesystem, object store, content-addressed store, physical disk, removable media). A value, not a StorageLocation subclass: the kinds share the same structure (path, service, holder, physical place).

Structure

Subclass of: gufo:QualityValue

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:StorageMedium as a specialized kind of gufo:QualityValue. Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.
